blocks.text: Department Mapping is used to categorize multiple organizational departments under a division to view metrics for the division. For example, if you have three departments in your organization that belong or relate to a division called Marketing, you can map these departments and view metrics specifically for the Marketing division in Workplace Insights.
Department Mapping provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Map departments to a division based on your requirements.
View workplace metrics based on divisions.

blocks.text: On the Department Mapping page (Workplace > Workplace Settings > Department Mapping), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Map a department. If you've added at least one mapping, the Add Departments option changes to Edit Mapping. Click Edit Mapping to map more departments.
View a list of mapped departments. For each mapping, you can view:
Division: The name of the division.
Departments: The departments that are mapped to the division.
Number of Departments: The number of departments mapped to the division.
Employees: The number of employees mapped to the division.
